result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by expressly eliminating liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer. It preserves the core commercial intent of providing Vendor relief for Customer-caused dependency delays through schedule relief and recovery of documented, reasonable incremental costs. However, it is not strictly minimal because it adds a new affirmative cost-recovery mechanism and narrows the triggering delay to material delays involving dependencies identified in an Order Form, rather than merely removing the liquidated-damages obligation. The drafting is otherwise professional and clear.
